title: Perform a full system upgrade
summary: Update the package database and upgrade all installed packages to their latest versions. This is the standard way to keep an Arch-based system up to date.

steps.explain: Synchronize the package database and upgrade all installed packages. Do not use 'pacman -Sy' alone, as partial upgrades are unsupported.

warnings: Ensure you have a backup or live USB available in case the update fails.
Read Arch Linux news before upgrading if you are unsure about recent changes.

rollback.explain: If the update fails or breaks the system, you may need to boot from a live USB and downgrade packages or restore a backup. There is no simple command to undo a partial or failed upgrade.
